title: Is Hermione warm-blooded? (native evaluator fixture)
question: Does the conclusion follow from the premises under the native deterministic evaluator?
description: The spec's canonical example (§6.3). Every claim carries Logic IR grounded to local concepts, so the native evaluator can derive, refuse, and explain. Commit 2 adds an argument whose conclusion does not follow and a claim with an unresolved term; the 'repair' branch supplies the missing premise so the evaluation flips.
